items.title: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
items.snippet: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
items.snippet: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC, ETH, SOL за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
